tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Call search_skills before starting any coding, deployment, debugging, design or prompt-writing task. Searches TheSkillVault, a library of vibe-coding skills and prompts. Returns names + one-line descriptions only; call get_skill to load the full instructions of the best match before doing the task.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Load the full SKILL.md instructions for one skill by exact name (from search_skills).

tools.name: get_skill_file
tools.description: Load one supporting file (e.g. references/env-vars.md) from a skill folder. Use the file list returned by get_skill.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List all skills (name, category, description), optionally filtered by category and/or AI model family.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Lists the AI model families skills can be filtered by (id, name, vendor), with how many skills match each: skills written specifically for that family plus skills written for any AI.

tools.name: list_bundles
tools.description: Lists skill bundles: ordered paths where each skill's output is the next skill's input (id, title, audience, number of steps).

tools.name: get_bundle
tools.description: Returns one bundle's ordered steps: skill name, what each step takes in and hands on, and its web link. Full instructions for a step come from get_skill.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "prompt:write-session-handoff-prompt" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: A prompt that compacts a long AI coding session into a short handoff document a fresh agent can pick up from, with links instead of copies and secrets redacted.…
